title: Paxton Carnegie Library, 254 South Market Street, Paxton, Ford County, IL
notes: Significance: The Paxton Carnegie Library is locally significant under Criterion A and C.  It is significant for educational purposes in its role in providing library services to the citizens of Paxton.  The building is also significant as a local architectural example of the Classic Revival/Beaus Arts style.  In addition, it is an example of a "Carnegie Library", meeting the criteria of the Carnegie Library property type.  The period of significance for the building is 1904, when it was built
